messages.content: You are diagnosing release-rubric FAIL marks. Judge only concrete unresolved defects supported by the supplied implementation facts. Output schema JSON only.

Diagnose the five FAIL marks only for exact SHA 577d5817c30baa4ed969b8af9de500e698d67159. Do not rubber-stamp. A CONCRETE_DEFECT must identify an actual unresolved defect in the source/evidence, not a future enhancement or absence of a live paid smoke test. If proof is missing, use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

Architecture facts: provider-neutral contract remains capabilities→estimate→prepare→generate→poll→collect→provenance. The new Higgsfield adapter is peripheral to ExecutionService and does not alter Graph Harness runtime. Existing synchronous FFmpeg/test adapters retain a dedicated non-async path. Existing human CRITIC/INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER/RELEASE stages remain unchanged.

Security/privacy facts: credentials are stored by existing AES-256-GCM IntegrationVault under private-integrations, key mode/owner checked 0600/no-follow, and are never included in provider/job/public projections. ProviderList only returns configured boolean. Output download rejects non-HTTPS, credential-bearing URLs, local/private/reserved literal IPs, DNS-resolved private/reserved addresses, validates every redirect, limits redirect count, timeout, bytes <=40MiB and MIME. No auth implementation changed. approve-provider-spend is session-authenticated, same-origin/CSRF protected by existing HTTP boundary, and service additionally requires tenant owner/admin.

Supply chain facts: package.json, pnpm-lock, Dockerfile, compose.host.yml and deployment scripts are unchanged from deployed baseline. pnpm audit --prod reports no known vulnerabilities. The adapter uses Node built-ins plus existing application modules; no new third-party dependency.

Agent/tool governance facts: no automatic publication. A paid request cannot be submitted until an authenticated owner/admin approves exact scope_sha binding job/revision/provider/model/request SHA/prompt SHA/estimate/input hashes. Changing a bound value invalidates approval. Missing credential fails before paid submit. reference/mascot inputs fail closed; no text-only fallback. failed/nsfw and ambiguous submit do not trigger blind paid retry.

State/concurrency facts: mutations use the existing AtomicRepository transaction queue and per-job lease. Durable attempt is written SUBMISSION_PENDING before POST. If response is ambiguous/no request id, restart fails closed rather than resubmit. Once request id is persisted, recovery polls the same id. If artifact collection completed before process loss, recovery validates stored artifact SHA/provenance and completes Graph without new provider request. recover() does not auto-resume AWAITING_SPEND_APPROVAL/BLOCKED/WAITING_EXTERNAL_GENERATION. Tests exercise duplicate-spend prevention, stale approval invalidation, moderation, ambiguous submit, request-id recovery and crash-after-collection.

Exact evidence: main full suite 198 discovered/197 PASS/0 FAIL/1 pre-existing SKIP; targeted V9/core 26/26 PASS; detached exact verifier 38/38 PASS + typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS; clean browser E2E PASS; clean non-test FIRMES completion PASS.
